#load libraries
```{r}
library("dplyr")
library("tidyr")
library("bigrquery")
library("DBI")
library("pheatmap")
library("RColorBrewer")
library("Rmisc")
library("stats")
library("rstatix")
library("ggplot2")
library("car")
detach(package:Rmisc)
detach(package:plyr)
```



#query data from BQ (just for chemicals of interest)
```{r}
# set up database connection
con <- dbConnect(
  bigrquery::bigquery(),
  project = "edf-aq-data",
  dataset = "airtoxscreen",)

SQL = "	
	SELECT *
	FROM `2020_ambient_concentrations_bysource_bychemical`
  WHERE pollutant_name IN ('BENZENE', 'ETHYLBENZENE', 'STYRENE', 'NAPHTHALENE')"

ats = dbGetQuery(con,SQL)
```
